name: cadenza-lsp
description: Cadenza language support — project-aware diagnostics, hover, semantic highlighting, go-to-definition, find-references, document highlight, rename, completion, document outline, workspace symbol search, folding, and quick-fixes, all served by `cdz lsp` (the compiler itself).

cadenza.server.path.description: Absolute path to the `cdz` binary that runs the LSP server (`cdz lsp`). When empty, the extension reads the path written by `cargo xtask install-lsp` (a `.cdz-server-path` file beside the extension), then falls back to `cdz` on PATH.

cadenza.trace.server.description: Trace the JSON-RPC traffic between VS Code and the `cdz lsp` server (for debugging the extension).
